title: The Bill Invoices To field searches customers by name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, so customer A has a default and its card shows Change.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, whose name contains a word no other customer's name contains.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Click "Change" beside "Bill Invoices To" on the left card.
  3. Type that word from customer C's name in the "Bill Invoices To" field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The left card shows "Bill Invoices To" and "Change".

Step 2:

  • The "Bill Invoices To" window opens.

Step 3:

  • The list narrows to "[customer A's name] (this customer)" first, then customer C.
  • No customer whose name lacks that word is listed.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R4: “The window has a searchable "Bill Invoices To" field and a "Save" button.”
  • S1-R5: “The field's first option is "[customer] (this customer)"; picking it and saving clears the default.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Change" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build), "Change, open" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build), "Open" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

The design's own words:

  • “Window "Bill Invoices To": "New work orders and part sales for Buda Truck Repair will be billed to this customer. Existing ones don't change."”
  • “The list opens above the field when there is no room below: "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)" first, then customers A to Z, the current pick "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair" highlighted. Closed without saving. Reshot after the tech review.”
  • “The list opens with "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)" first, then customers A to Z. The current pick, "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", is highlighted in its A to Z place. Picking "(this customer)" and saving clears the default.”

Difference BT-D03 on S1-R4 (BT-D03 extra Cancel (and x)): this case follows the PRD; the design's version is asked in question 6.
